root_cause: WebKit could expose transient or inconsistently-updated viewport dimensions during launch/resume, allowing width and height to resolve from different effective viewport states
viewport_policy: measure one visualViewport snapshot; compute both stage width and height atomically; resync on launch, resume, resize, orientationchange, and visualViewport changes
guard: conceal the stage only while a materially changed viewport is stabilizing; unchanged normal resume does not intentionally route through title
resume: preserve current screen; same-session reload restores HOME/mode/encyclopedia/records/settings
state_storage: sessionStorage only; no long-term screen-state persistence
fail_closed: missing/corrupt resume state returns to title
